line: We crashed. We are alive, but we are stranded on this island, and my leg is hurt.
Look at that sky. A storm is coming in fast. We need a plan before it hits.
All we have is the damaged radio, Sam's toolkit, Welsy's rope, my first-aid kit, and only two bottles of water.
If any of us gets off this island, we send help back for whoever is still here. Agreed?
Agreed. Nobody gets left behind for good.
